object_types.name: Person
object_types.definition: Anyone in the system, identified by a person ID

source_references.excerpt: We track persons generally -- anyone in the system is a person with a person ID.

object_types.name: Employee
object_types.definition: A person who is employed; every employee is also a person

source_references.excerpt: Employees are persons; every employee is also a person, identified the same way.
Managers. A manager is an employee with extra responsibilities. Every manager is an employee, and through that, a person.

object_types.name: Department
object_types.definition: An organizational unit that employees work in and managers may manage

source_references.excerpt: Each department has a department code.

object_types.name: Department Name
object_types.definition: The text name of a department

source_references.excerpt: Departments also each have a department name, like "Payroll" or "Field Operations", and no two share a name.

fact_types.name: Employee works in Department
readings: Department is worked in by Employee

source_references.excerpt: Every employee works in exactly one department. Departments have many employees, but nobody is in two departments at once, and nobody is unassigned.
A manager manages at most one department. Some managers are between assignments and manage none.
